adjudicates: NOTHING. Floors are derived on the measurement frame at measurement time (EPOCH_2026_PREREGISTRATION.md protocol step 1); these numbers exist to size expectations for the V1 label advance and may not be cited as floors, margins, or verdicts.
registration: docs/efv-2026-08-19/EPOCH_2026_PREREGISTRATION.md (Power projection section); companion on the conviction program V1 lane
claim_frame: CONVICTION_PROGRAM.md V5, C1-C4, Holm across four, E_cond primary

method.scaling: sd^2 split into refit component (held fixed) and sampling component (scaled by n_cur/n_proj); MDE95 = 1.645 * sd one-sided
direction_of_error: refit component held fixed: more training labels should shrink refit noise, so E_refit projections are conservative (too high)

sqrt-n on headcount ignores censoring: 2025-cohort rows carry 2 observed seasons (weight 1/3 in pair-weighted rho, noisier KM labels in AUC), so projected reductions are OVERSTATED, especially for the weighted Spearman cells
entry rates are 14-year averages; recent cohorts are covered more densely, so headcount increments are modestly understated
C1/C2 may also gain earlier-debut players whose decision year is 2025 (new fold); not counted, increments understated there

cohort.side_rule: position all pitcher tokens (P/SP/RP/SIRP/MIRP/LHP/RHP) -> pit, else hit

context_floors_not_projected.note: xfv_mde_floor.json is the 11-fold pooled-rho floor (0.044 convention); it is not a claim-frame cell and is listed for orientation only

refit share 0.1283 transferred from the headtohead_common cell (verified from stored sds, stored value 0.128); assumption: it transfers from the all-vintages frame to the vintage-matched frame

per_cell.C1: NO. Pooled vintage-matched delta vs best rater is negative; a 4-5 pct floor reduction cannot clear a negative delta. Resolution requires the delta itself to move (V2/V3), or the per-side measurement to land far from the pooled read.
per_cell.C3: CLOSEST BUT NO at the stored margin. Projected E_cond floor stays above the stored 0.00965 consensus-baseline margin even in the most favorable Holm slot, and the best-rater comparator can only tighten the margin.
per_cell.C4: NO. Stored margin sits near 0.2x of the projected floor.

honest_read.expected_value_of_V1: a 4-8 pct floor reduction across the four cells plus the first pitcher-stuff fold; the label-pool lever alone does not resolve the claim frame at current deltas, matching the prereg's 'no cell clears' pre-committed interpretation as the central expectation.
